ref_text: The lane was busy, and nobody looked twice.

lines.text: You there, keep a hand on your wallet. There's a pickpocket at the east gate.
Did you hear? There's a pickpocket at the east gate, everyone's saying it!
East gate, saab. Pickpocket. Police are going there now.
lines.text_kokoro: East gate, [saab](/sˈɑːb/). Pickpocket. Police are going there now.

lines.text: He's at the west gate, where he took a wallet in the very first second.
So the three people who warned you were one man, three times.
They sounded like three witnesses, and not one of them had seen him,
but he'd seen every hand go to a pocket, yours too.
So while the police ran east and grabbed the first man they saw running,
he walked back through every pocket he'd watched them touch.
You there, keep a hand on your wallet.
